caveats:
Administrative units have the following P-code structure:

Administrative level 0 (country):  VU
Administrative level 1 (province):  VUnn
Administrative level 2 (area council):  VUnnnnn

In addition, administrative level 1 includes the alternate national system:  VU-XXX
dataset_source: PopGIS2: Secretarial of the Pacific Community (SPC), Statistics for Development Division (http://vanuatu.popgis.spc.int/#l=en;v=map4)
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
name: cod-ab-vut
notes:
Vanuatu administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 6 nan  
- Admin 2: 66 nan  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 31 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 24 August 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 31 October 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 31 October 2017: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Office of the Pacific Islands](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rop).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
